methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search charcoal and kamado grill models spanning kettle, kamado, and drum/barrel types. Specifications were independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (weber.com, biggreenegg.com, kamadojoe.com, chargriller.com, charbroil.com, pkgrills.com, oklahomajoes.com, royalgourmetusa.com, napoleon.com) and corroborated with major retailers and review aggregators (homedepot.com, lowes.com, amazon.com, amazingribs.com, atbbq.com, biggreeneggprices.com). priceUsd reflects the US MSRP or list price found on the manufacturer or primary retailer page at time of access; sale or discounted prices are not used. Boolean spec fields (hinged_cooking_grate, ash_catcher, built_in_thermometer) are true when the feature ships standard with the base product, false when absent. Strings carry inline units. Notable adversarial corrections this pass: Original Kettle Premium source URL was pointing to a Performer page (fixed); Char-Griller AKORN primary cooking area corrected 310->325 sq in per chargriller.com; Char-Broil Kettleman built_in_thermometer corrected false->true (lid-mounted gauge is standard) and diameter 21->22.5 in; Napoleon corroboration URL was pointing to the wrong model (NK18K) and was replaced with the NK22K listing. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

specs.material: Porcelain-enameled bowl and lid, 304 stainless steel EasySpin cooking grate

products.provenance: Primary source is the archived official SnS Grills product page for this exact model ("Slow 'N Sear® Deluxe Kettle Grill" / "Slow 'N Sear® Charcoal Kettle Grill & Smoker"), fetched from the Wayback Machine (2024-03-05 capture, HTTP 200) because the live snsgrills.com page now 404s (product discontinued, succeeded by the MasterKettle). The page confirms verbatim: a 22" kettle-style charcoal grill with a 304 stainless steel 22" EasySpin grill grate, a black porcelain-enameled finish ("Color: Black (Porcelain Enamel)"), a larger porcelain-coated charcoal grate, a side shelf, lid cradle, and a "5 vent no-touch ash removal system"; specs list "Cooking Grate: 22 inches" and "Weight: 38 pounds." Adversarial re-verify (2026-07-10): material trimmed to drop the unsupported "steel" substrate claim — the page states "Porcelain Enamel" as the finish but never describes the bowl/lid as steel (the only "steel" mentioned is the 304 stainless EasySpin grate). built_in_thermometer=false because the grill provides a ½" "Probe Port" for inserting a digital thermometer rather than a built-in lid gauge. Left null (not stated): primary_cooking_area_sqin (no square-inch figure given), hinged_cooking_grate (grate is described as "EasySpin," never "hinged"), and ash_catcher (an "ash removal system" is described but no catcher pan/bin is stated). release=2020 from the page's "Best New Product of 2020" (amazingribs.com/Meathead Goldwyn) award, consistent with the first Wayback capture dated 14 Aug 2020. Corroboration is null: no retailer page exists for this exact discontinued kettle — current listings are the successor MasterKettle/Black Edition grills or the standalone Slow 'N Sear Deluxe insert (the ATBBQ listing sells the charcoal-basket insert, not the full kettle), and Lowe's returns 403 with no Wayback snapshot.
